- **`remove_item/3`**: subtracts units. If you remove as many units as the cart holds, or more, the item is dropped. Removing a SKU (stock-keeping unit, the item ID) that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
- **`apply_code/2`**: accepts the strings `"SAVE10"` a
